source.text:
大型团队可以避雷了！

我们是120人的团队，提前定好了菜单（4冷8热一汤），酒水预订了6瓶啤酒，1大瓶可乐，1大瓶橙汁（只是为了桌面好看），现场再看客人需要现点酒水。

提前跟餐厅说好时间（预计19点），从展馆出发前，特意给大堂经理打了电话，告知我们20分钟后到，第一辆车40人，其他随后就到，可以准备出热菜了，餐厅告知，凉菜已经布好。

我们准时于19点到，随即服务员把汤上到桌上。我们总共预订了15桌，前面说了，每桌6瓶啤酒，结果没有一桌桌上有开瓶器！得现场找服务员开瓶，100多人，现场那个混乱。

客人入座后，汤很快上来，凉菜也已经摆好，我们以为一切都会很顺利，结果，噩梦开始了：

从19:05开始上汤，到19:30，所有的热菜（每道都是15盘，因为开了15桌），在短短的5分钟内全部都来了。

请注意时间差，从19:05-19:25，整整20分钟，全部贵宾只能面对4个凉菜喝啤酒，随着我不断的找大堂经理催促，找跑堂去问，只告知必须等，没法上菜，我特意跟大堂经理说，不要等所有的菜都齐了再端出来，做好一道就出一道。可惜还是没有得到有效解决方案。

我想问是：大堂经理和跑堂一直说，他们做好一道就出一道，那么为什么会在最后5分钟，8个热菜，每道15份，就都出现在我们面前？ 师傅出菜的速度这么快？长了三头六臂？ 还是故意的放在厨房，等8个菜都齐了才一起推出来？是怕我们一道一道吃会吃的很干净，又担心我们不付钱去加菜？

有一个16人超大圆桌，服务员一开始就说了，菜都是双份，结果… 在等热菜的过程中… 上了4盘土豆丝（不是两盘）和4盘另外一个凉菜（我不记得是什么了）。真慷慨！

而且在等待过程中，服务员却一直在给宾客推荐酒水，虽然酒水允许暴利，我们又不是不额外点，有必要做的这么难看吗？热菜早点上，客人满意了，酒水会少点吗？
source.textTranslated:
Large groups should avoid this place!

We were a group of 120 people. We had pre-ordered the menu (4 cold dishes, 8 hot dishes, and 1 soup), and reserved 6 bottles of beer, 1 large bottle of cola, and 1 large bottle of orange juice (just for table decoration). We planned to order drinks on-site if needed.

We had arranged the time with the restaurant in advance (estimated 7 PM). Before leaving the exhibition hall, we specifically called the lobby manager to let them know we would arrive in 20 minutes, the first bus would have 40 people, and the rest would arrive shortly after, so they could start preparing the hot dishes. The restaurant informed us that the cold dishes were already set out.

We arrived on time at 7 PM, and the waiter immediately brought the soup to the table. We had reserved 15 tables in total, and as mentioned before, each table was supposed to have 6 bottles of beer. However, none of the tables had bottle openers! We had to ask the waiters on-site to open the bottles. With over 100 people, the scene was chaotic.

After the guests were seated, the soup arrived quickly, and the cold dishes were already laid out. We thought everything would go smoothly, but then the nightmare began:

From 7:05 PM, when the soup started serving, to 7:30 PM, all the hot dishes (each dish consisting of 15 plates, as 15 tables were booked) appeared within a mere 5 minutes.

Please note the time difference: from 7:05 PM to 7:25 PM, a full 20 minutes, all the VIPs were only able to drink beer with four cold dishes. Despite my repeated inquiries to the manager and waiters, I was only told that we had to wait and couldn't serve any more food. I specifically told the manager not to wait for all the dishes to be served before bringing them out, but to serve them one at a time as they were prepared. Unfortunately, I still didn't get a satisfactory solution.

My question is: the manager and waiters kept saying they would serve one dish at a time, so why did all eight hot dishes, 15 servings each, appear in front of us in the last 5 minutes? Were the chefs serving food that fast? Did they have three heads and six arms? Or were they deliberately left in the kitchen until all eight dishes were served before bringing them out together? Were they afraid we'd eat everything cleanly, one dish at a time, and then worry we wouldn't pay for more?

There was a huge round table for 16 people. The waiter said from the beginning that all dishes were served in double portions, but… while waiting for the hot dishes… they brought out four plates of shredded potatoes (not two plates) and four other cold dishes (I don't remember what they were). How generous!

Furthermore, while we were waiting, the waiters kept recommending drinks to the guests. Even though drinks are allowed to be sold at exorbitant prices, it's not like we won't order extra. Was it really necessary to make it so unpleasant? If the hot dishes were served earlier, and the guests were satisfied, wouldn't there be fewer drinks?
